method.title: AI-Augmented Delivery
method.intro: AI is the reason a one-person project can carry the scope of a team's. It is not the reason the code is correct — that is still process. Nor does it work on its own: it takes a clean context window, detailed specifications and good memory management, which only come with practice and understanding. This is how I combine it all.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Web Developer with a Higher Technical degree in Web Application Development (DAW), over a year of hands-on experience at Servibyte S.L., and the solo author of Between, a live production product with real users.
about.p2: I designed, built and shipped Between solo, game mechanics, security and privacy policy included: per-couple isolation with Row Level Security, 800+ unit tests and 185 SQL migrations. I use AI as an engineering instrument: I write the specification first, direct the implementation and review every piece before it ships.
about.p3: On GestiCAB V4 I did the opposite: inherited someone else's code, cleaned it up and upgraded it from PHP 7.4 to 8.3 and Laravel 7 to 13 with 189 tests green. I'm looking for a team that reviews each other's work and debates its decisions.
